Player.Bio:
Multi-sport athlete that also plays baseball and competes in track and field events.
––––
TRACK & FIELD
Ran a 23.31 200 and long jumped 22-1.75 as a sophomore, per MileSplit. 
Freshman markers included a 23.56 200, 22-1 long jump, and 41-10.5 triple jump.
––––
FOOTBALL
2025: MVP of the Navy All-American Bowl. Led the West to a 13-7 victory, scoring points on 2 of his 3 drives at QB. Completed 3 of 5 passes for 146 yards – that included a 91-yard TD to Jalen Cooper – while also rushing for 30 sack-adjusted yards.
2024: Posted a 6-4 starting record as a junior. Completed 173 of 263 passes (65.7%) for 2,689 yards and 25 TDs. Added 347 yards and 7 TDs on the ground.
2023: Led Legacy School of Sports Sciences to an 8-1 record as the team's starting QB. Completed 122 of 210 passes (58%) for 2,025 yards with 28 TD and 3 INT. Added 21 carries for 76 yards (3.61 YPC) and 4 TD. Also played some defense where he totaled 4 INT.
2022: Primarily played WR as a freshman, accumulating 74 receptions for 1,135 yards and 14 TDs on 15.3 yards per catch in 12 games.
-Gabe Brooks and Andrew Ivins

Player.Bio:
Multi-sport athlete.
––––
TRACK & FIELD
-2x Gatorade Missouri Boys Track & Field Player of the Year.
-2x Missouri Class 5A state champion in the shot put. Took first at the event at Nike Outdoor Nationals meet in 2024.
-Owns a personal-best 74-9.75 effort in the shot put – which is the national high school record for a sophomore – and a 205-4 effort in the discus.
––––
FOOTBALL
2025: Gatorade National Player of the Year. Helped Nixa go 13-1 and reach Missouri's Class 6A championship. Racked up 173 pancake blocks through first 13 games.
2024: Missouri Gatorade Player of the Year. Registered 158 pancake blocks over the course of the season.
2023: Starting LT for Nixa, which went undefeated in Central Ozark Conference play. Credited with 91 pancake blocks and 0 sacks allowed.
-Andrew Ivins

Player.Bio:
Multi-sport athlete who competes in track and field. Two-way player with extensive snaps on the offensive and defensive lines.
––––
TRACK & FIELD
-As a junior, won the Louisiana 3A discus championship (151-6) in outdoor competition, which followed a Louisiana indoor shot put state title (54-4). Set a Spring 2025 shot put best of 56-2.75 in indoor action, per MileSplit.
Louisiana 3A state shot put champion (53-1) as a sophomore. Also placed fourth at regionals in the discus (132-3), per MileSplit.
-As a freshman, placed second in the Louisiana 3A shot put finals with a 50-4 in May 2023. Threw 52-7 earlier in the spring and won a district title with a 50-6. Also qualified for state in the discus, finishing third at regionals with a 124-10. Posted a 126-11 season-best discus in March 2023.
––––
FOOTBALL
2026: Participated in the Under Armour All-America Game (1 sack, 1 TFL).
2025: MaxPreps All-America selection on offense as a junior. Got snaps on both sides of the ball.
2024: Two-way player. Earned MaxPreps Junior All-America first-team honors as an offensive lineman. 
2023: MaxPreps Sophomore All-America first-team offensive line selectoin.
2022: Gained extensive two-way snaps as a freshman. MaxPreps Freshman All-America second-team o-line selection.
- Gabe Brooks

Player.Bio:
Multi-sport athlete that has also played basketball at the prep level.
––––
FOOTBALL
2025: MaxPreps All-American. Led Nashville Christian to its second consecutive Tennessee Division II Class A championship. Posted a 11-0 record. Finished senior season going 141 of 214 passing (65.9%) for  2,073 yards with 36 TD and 6 INT. Ran for 614 yards and 11 TD. 
2024: MaxPreps Tennessee Player of the Year and a MaxPreps Junior All-American. Powered Nashville Christian to a 12-1 record and a Tennessee Division II-A state championship, the school's first in 9 years. Earned Mr. Football honors for his classification. Completed 179 of 255 passes (70.2%) for 2,830 yards with 40 TD and 3 INT. Also carried the ball 88 times for 637 yards (7.2 YPC) and 18 TD.
2023: Led the Eagles to the state semifinals while posting a 6-7 record. Completed 180 for 321 pass attempts (56.1%) for 2,522 yards with 25 TD and 9 INT. Also ran for 543 yards and 13 TD while averaging 5.4 ypc.
2022: Runner-up for Tennessee’s Mr. Football as a freshman. Posted a 10-3 record and got Nashville Christian to the Division II-A title game. Completed 123 of 208 pass attempts (59.1%) for 2,285 yards with 27 TD and 8 INT. Also carried the ball 61 times for 481 yards and 7 TD.
-Andrew Ivins

Player.Bio:
FOOTBALL
2026: Returned to the Under Armour All-America Game (1 tackle). 
2025: MaxPreps All-American. Baltimore All-Metro Player of the Year. Finished senior season with 72 tackles (20 TFL), 12 sacks and 4 FF. Participated in both the Under Armour All-America Game (1 sack, 1 TFL, 1 FF) and the Polynesian Bowl (1 tackle, 1 QBH) in January.
2024: MaxPreps Junior All-American. Transferred into Baltimore St. Frances where he totaled 56 tackles (28 TFL), 10 sacks, 7 PBU and 3 FF.
2023: As a sophomore, racked up 64 tackles (24 TFL) and 13 sacks at Maryland's Joppatowne High.
-Andrew Ivins
